notes.title: Update - Build 1.0.0.68
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39148619/ddf5382c031345c1222764841f6f2803ed9cb614.png
Hi folks,

I've just put out an update for the game. Here is a list of what has changed:

Created a cinematic trailer showcasing new lore-backed artworks.
Re-created gameplay trailer.
Re-created screenshots.
Re-formatted store page long description.
Re-formatted store page short description.
Completely revamped all store and library assets.
Completely revamped main menu UI.
Replaced manual copyright sprite with an IDE-based text field for easier maintenance.
Added "resolution" to the interpolation warning string.
Disabled texture interpolation by default. This will enhance visuals significantly on resolutions that are 1920x1080 and higher, but worsen them for resolutions that are lower. If issues occur, simply press "I" to enable interpolation at any point in the game.
Completely overhauled introduction sequence and artwork.
Implemented an unused sound effect asset to the introduction sequence to enhance the narrative and atmosphere of the game's story.
After the tutorial is complete, the player is now restored to full HP, Hunger, and Thirst.
All Tool Ion attacks on enemies and NPCs now consume 1 SP per hit.
Doubled the base spawn rate of enemies from 1 per 6 seconds to 1 per 3 seconds.
Halved the base limit of enemies from 8 to 4.
Increased enhanced limit of enemies when using a Cursed Soul by 6x the new base of 4, totaling 24.
Halved the enhanced spawn rate of enemies when using a Cursed Soul from 1 per 3 seconds to 1 per 1.5 seconds.
Added boss enemies to the game. When using a Cursed Soul, 4 bosses will also spawn. These bosses cannot be targeted by turrets, but they will damage them (+25%) if they are caught in the crossfire. If caught in their blast radius, the player will take extreme damage. Bosses grant additional XP, which stacks with the C.A.N. Opener Jumpsuit's 2x Combat XP buff. Also, additional loot is dropped (6-18 Cola Tabs, a random S.E.L.F. tab, and 9-27 Power Cells). These new foes also do twice the usual damage to the player's C.A.N. and should be dealt with swiftly.
Added Repair Kit (1-3) and Power Cell (9-27) to the base enemy's loot tables. This is in an effort to reduce early-game difficulty, and the additional ammunition seems to add to the fun - especially when combined with the new Cursed Soul overhaul.
Increased ambient lighting factor from 0.022 to 0.5 - a whopping 2,272.73% increase in lighting.
Added 4 torches to The Void, which make the C.A.N.'s perimeter a bit brighter.
Reduced enemy sound effect volume by about 15%.
Amended Amborettio_credits.txt to include important information about new artworks.
Increased size 12 font range from 32-127 to 32-255 to allow for use of symbols.
Fixed a typo in the EULA.

notes.title: Update - Build 1.0.0.64
notes.notes:
Hi folks,

I've just put out an update for the game. Here is a list of what has changed:

Replaced the Void's C.A.N. sprites to be more seamless.
Texture interpolation can now be toggled on/off by pressing "I" at any time. This is enabled by default, but makes almost no visual difference when toggled on 1920x1080 resolutions, therefore it can be disabled without issue. However, resolutions below 1920x1080 will require this setting to be enabled, or text will not display properly.

notes.title: Update - Build 1.0.0.59
notes.notes:
Hi folks,

I've just put out an update for the game. Here is a list of what has changed:

Fixed a critical issue related to resolution scaling. All resolutions should now scale properly, with the exception of text legibility at lower resolutions.
Enabled texture interpolation, allowing lower resolutions to have better text legibility. This does not appear to negatively impact visuals at the recommended resolution of 1920x1080.
Fixed an issue where enemies could spawn along the sides of the Void, they now only spawn on the outer boundaries of the C.A.N.'s cavern, as intended.
Fixed a layering issue where blood could spawn in the darkness of the Void when shooting at enemies outside of the Void's boundaries.


This update is pretty significant, so I'm elaborating on some of these changes:

Your desktop's native resolution will automatically be detected and scaled to fit Amborettio's UI.

Resolutions below 1280x720 will have text that is completely illegible, so these resolutions cannot be supported. Unfortunately, visual quality will diminish the lower the resolution is from 1920x1080.

While I am happy to say that this update will allow many to play the game without issue, I cannot recommend playing below 1920x1080.

Below is a visual representation of 1920x1080 resolution without interpolation (top image) and with interpolation (bottom image). 

Without texture interpolation enabled, resolutions below 1920x1080 would be completely illegible.

notes.title: Update - Build 1.0.0.51
notes.notes:
Hi folks,

I've just put out an update for the game. Here is a list of what has changed:

Player damage now matches the default amount of damage that turrets do, and scales identically when using Weapon Upgrade Parts.
Fixed a visual bug related to map borders caused by previous brightness update.
Allocating S.E.L.F. points to Strength or picking up Strength tabs will now grant +15 Max WT per point, compared to the previous amount of +5. This should prevent near-constant over-encumbrance in the late-game.
Reduced the overall time it takes for a turret upgrade to finish. Instead of this taking 11 seconds, it now takes 5.5. This should allow for faster and more efficient progression with turrets.
